e.g., Sequel to an earlier instruction you gave us on the 4th day of january, 2026 to carry out negotiations for the sale of your property located at Plot 5 Ahmadu Bello Way, Central Business District, Abuja for the sum of N10,000,000.00 (Ten Million Naira), we wish to inform you that all negotiations have been concluded for the sale.

e.g, We therefore require that you come to our office for further instructions so as to enable us proceed with execution.

Yours faithfully,
